page_title: LEV 1-1 MON | Bayer Leverkusen v B. Monchengladbach 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+6' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.

90+2' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
90+2' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for B. Monchengladbach.
90+1' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
89' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
86' Substitution. Rocco Reitz makes way for Charles Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Eugen Polanski has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Fabio Cristian Chiarodia.
84' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
84' Here's the change. Ibrahim Maza leaves the pitch and Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.

83' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
83' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) heads on.
80' The substitution has been made. Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) has replaced Shuto Machino.
80' Here is a change. Kevin Stoger is going off and Eugen Polanski gives the last tactical orders to Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach).
79' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

77' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Mark Flekken thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
76' A substitution has been made. Patrik Schick goes off and Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
76' Kasper Hjulmand decides to make a substitution. Eliesse Ben Seghir will be replaced by Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen).
74' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) has tested the patience of referee Felix Zwayer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Mark Flekken was alert and made an amazing save!
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) will replace Jens Castrop.
70' 1 - 0 Goal! Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
69' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) connects with a precise cross from the corner kick, but his close -range header hits one of his teammates and thus the score doesn't change.
69' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
68' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
65' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a sweet pass into the box towards Patrik Schick. He looks to dribble past an opposing player, but fails and the ball is cleared.
63' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to make a change. Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Lucas Vazquez.
63' It will be a substitution. Axel Tape (Bayer Leverkusen) is ready to enter the pitch as Loic Bade walks off.
62' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.

60' Mark Flekken pulls off a fantastic save! Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
57' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
57' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
56' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is caught offside!
55' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) commits a rough foul. Felix Zwayer stops the game and makes a call. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick.
53' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) passes the ball onto Ibrahim Maza, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
52' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
49' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
49' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the bottom right corner, but it wasn't dangerous and Moritz Nicolas made a comfortable save.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Rough tackle by Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.

40' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Mark Flekken leaps like a salmon to deny him. The ball goes out for a corner. B. Monchengladbach can continue in their attacking effort.
39' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) for his blatant foul.
39' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
37' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
36' Good defending. Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Patrik Schick inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
34' Felix Zwayer blows for a foul after Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
30' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
24' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The B. Monchengladbach players look gutted.
24' The B. Monchengladbach players halt their celebrations as referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
23' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
20' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
19' A cross from a corner kick by B. Monchengladbach is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.

16' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken pulls off a comfortable save.
12' The ball falls for Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there!

9' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
8' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
6' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.
2' A long ball forward to Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted.
1' The first half has just begun.
B. Monchengladbach will kick the game off.
Felix Zwayer is introduced as the referee for today's match.
